en_US: My Eevee evolved into an Espeon.
But my friend’s Eevee turned into
an Umbreon.
I wonder why? We both were raising
our Eevee in the same way...
If you use Revive, a Pokémon that has
fainted will wake right up.
Fantina: Ohohoho!! You must be a
Trainer, non?
I have come from Sinnoh, and so
this region is très mystérieuse!
Enfin, I will explore! But you are
the first Trainer I have met.
I say to myself, I shall give you
a gift!
And so I will!
Fantina: Will-o-Wisp is a spooky move!
A ghost move? Non!
But you will find many Ghost Pokémon
learn this technique!
Fantina: The Sinnoh region has what
is known as Super Contests.
Enfin, I aim to be fantastique!
Ils sont un grand spectacle!
